title: Oxygen-Evolving Manganese Ferrite Nanovesicles for Hypoxia-Responsive Drug Delivery and Enhanced Cancer Chemoimmunotherapy
notes: No intro/methods in the packet: HYP/DES/PRC nodes are text with requires_unseen. Spine: 20 nodes; after n10 (hypoxia-driven dissociation) two parallel branches, Dox release -> hypoxia-selective cytotoxicity and catalase activity -> in vivo hypoxia relief, converge on n16 (joint causes), which leads to survival (n20) and, through the immune-memory bridge n17, to relapse prevention (n18). Side: size control (s1, s2) and biodistribution (s3). Audits: a1 (liver outweighs tumour in F3a), a2 (sO2 halves by 48 h in F3e), a3 (rising residual H2O2 and marker-free traces in F1n). Packet defects: the F1i crop holds only the 2 h frame of a four-frame panel; the F1c crop has ocr letter None although the panel is labelled C, and its 'annotations' list is only the scale bar 'sonm'; the F1d 'annotation' 'Etios' is the misread 1 um scale bar; F1c/F1d caption spans are stitched from two caption clauses; F4 and F5 are tier C with no panels offered although both figures carry 10 and 9 lettered panels; the F5 crop letters skip I and use L.

split_nodes.why: the label stated two claims from two different endpoints: tumour volume held near 250 mm3 to day 20 (F4B,C) and every mouse alive past day 30 (F4D). They are causally sequential, so they become two nodes joined by causes. o14 evidences n16, o15 evidences n20. n20 is spine.

the label stated two claims from two different animal models: suppression of the rechallenged tumour after resection (F5B) and suppression of lung metastasis in the separate i.v. 4T1 model (F5G,H). n18 keeps the relapse claim on the spine; n21 is the lung-metastasis claim, spine false (side), explained by n17 and supporting n19, so the spine stays at the 20-node ceiling.

the OBS node read two panels of two different experiments in one label. o18 now reads the secondary-tumour volume, o19 the lung-nodule counts. The staff build file had merged F5B and F5H deliberately; the merge does not survive the one-claim rule because the two panels report different models.

source_changes.why: the claim is the three bar values (84, 76, 7%), which are read against the F3g axis, and the quantity is written on the panel. The ImageJ / >10 micrographs fact is provenance, not a fact the claim needs, so requires_unseen is now empty and the fact moved to image_note.

the claim names IR780-labelled Dox-MVs and post-injection time points. No panel shows that the fluorescent agent is IR780-labelled Dox-MVs; that comes from the F3 caption, and no upstream node declares it. requires_unseen now lists it.

pairs.cause: Self-assembly of block copolymer-tethered MFNs into nanovesicles via solvent exchange
pairs.effect: Monolayer of highly densely packed MFNs in the vesicular membrane
pairs.note: n7 (solvent-exchange co-assembly) produces n8 (hollow spheres whose membrane is a single densely packed MFN monolayer), evidenced by o1 (TEM/SEM/HAADF) and o2 (Fe/Mn maps). The graft-density size control of the MatMech experiment is carried by s1 and o3, with the 121 nm down-select s2.

pairs.cause: Monolayer of highly densely packed MFNs in the vesicular membrane
pairs.note: the graph has both endpoints and a path between them (n8 supports n10, n10 causes n13), but the sign is reversed: in the graph the intact densely packed monolayer is the inactive state. o7 reads 92% residual H2O2 and about 2 ppm O2 for intact MVs against 28% and 54 ppm for dissociated MVs, and n13 is labelled 'only dissociated MVs consume H2O2 and evolve O2'. Catalytic activity follows the loss of the cause state (n10), not the cause state itself. The MatMech record's own deductive line names dissociation, but its cause/effect pair does not. a3 further qualifies n13: residual H2O2 rises 28 -> 38 -> 40 uM over the repeat cycles.

pairs.cause: Self-assembly of block copolymer-tethered MFNs into nanovesicles via solvent exchange
pairs.effect: Enhanced tumor inhibition and long-term immunological memory in cancer chemoimmunotherapy
pairs.note: the whole spine tail carries this pair: n7 -> n8 -> n10 -> {n12, n13} -> {n14, n15} -> n16 (joint) -> n20, and n17 bridges to n18 and n21. The ten-group ranking (o14), survival (o15), CD8+/Treg and cytokines (o16), memory T cells (o17), rechallenge (o18) and lung nodules (o19) are all present. Not in the graph: the Dox-GVs inert control as its own node (it sits in o16's image_note), the T2-weighted MR panel F3c and the H&E/TUNEL panels.
